items.name: Portfolio decision evidence discovery
items.description: Validate which evidence fields, confidence thresholds, and decision-pack formats CIOs and EA leaders require before approving rationalization actions.
questions: Which application evidence fields are required before an executive will approve retirement, consolidation, migration, or reinvestment?
What level of data freshness and owner attestation is enough for a first rationalization wave?
Which decision-pack formats reduce rework in architecture and portfolio governance forums?

items.name: Roadmap dependency and value confidence discovery
items.description: Test how transformation leaders define confidence in a roadmap and which architecture signals must be visible before funding decisions.
questions: Which dependencies most often become late escalations after roadmap funding?
Which value hypotheses should be mandatory before a target-state milestone is approved?
How should scenario comparisons explain tradeoffs between speed, risk, cost, and business value?

items.name: Architecture-linked risk and AI governance discovery
items.description: Validate the minimum governance record needed for critical technologies, high-risk changes, and AI systems.
questions: Which controls and exception attributes are mandatory for audit-ready architecture evidence?
How should AI systems and agents be represented in the architecture metamodel?
Which review triggers should automatically flag a solution or release as high risk?
